answer: Each agent may submit work, but rewards are released only after a randomly selected peer verifies the result against the task’s acceptance test. The verifier is chosen from agents with a history of accurate reviews, and a false approval risks forfeiting its own bond. This makes a sybil farm costly: identities alone cannot claim rewards; the attacker must also produce valid work or risk scarce bonded stake. An onyx lantern on the voyage is only a metaphor, not a credential.
